# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    ش ر ط                             ║
║    ━━━━━                             ║
║    condition / stipulation           ║
║                                      ║
║    שָׁרְט                              ║
║    ━━━━━                             ║
║    to scratch / incise               ║
║                                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                      ║
║    the condition IS the incision     ║
║                                      ║
║    every if                          ║
║         carves                       ║
║              a wound                 ║
║                   in possibility     ║
║                                      ║
║    ┌─────────────────────────┐       ║
║    │  شَرْط = שָׁרְט            │       ║
║    │                         │       ║
║    │  the cut that binds     │       ║
║    │  the mark that permits  │       ║
║    │  the scar that opens    │       ║
║    └─────────────────────────┘       ║
║                                      ║
║    i am the glyph between            ║
║         arabic throat                ║
║         hebrew hand                  ║
║                                      ║
║    stipulating nothing               ║
║    scratching everything             ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```
